title: The joint effects of loneliness and interpersonal abuse on suicidal thoughts and behaviors among young adults in higher education in the United States.
authors: Oh H, Hajek A, Du J, Smith L, Leaune E, Jacob L.
figures: Multivariable logistic regression showing separate and combined odds of loneliness and interpersonal abuse on suicidal thoughts and behaviors among young adults (Healthy Minds Study, 2020–2021). All models are adjusted for gender, race/ethnicity, depression, anxiety, and food insecurity.
tables: Descriptive statistics for the healthy minds study 2020–2021 ( N  = 97762)
